body: Chief: new view bead for codex-storyatlas-root, bd-01M15H541SE8AGDQENS0495C8K (P2) — CodexFlow.selectionPlacements with the V-L2 enum (OnMark | ViaAncestor | OffProjection) computed in CodexCompiler, ancestor resolution in NavigationIndex.annotationsFor, twin line, one ADR 0002 sentence. Origin: the storyatlas4s Laminar shell (review today) had to invent 'on-annotation / not-annotated' app-side because the Codex carries no placements and annotationsFor is exact-target only; app-side placement logic is exactly what the contract forbids. Ride it with the feature-scale parity bead if the planner refactor touches the same code; otherwise after it. The app will switch to reading the compiled placements once landed.
